entities.summary: Mark Rozovsky (b. 1937-04-03, Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky) was a journalist or media commentator of the Modern era, defined by industrialization, revolution, and global conflict, active in Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky. Known in the fields of poets & playwrights.
